original.target_description: Published article identified: Ahlerup, Baskaran and Bigsten (2016), Government Impartiality and Sustained Growth in Sub-Saharan Africa. Multiple pooled OLS and fixed-effects regressions of sustained growth and related robustness tests are reported; the assigned input does not identify a unique outcome, coefficient, model column or analytic sample.
